listenAddr.description: The address the SCEP bridge will listen add

challengeFile.description: The file that contains the static challenge string

kubernetesRole.description: Role used for Kubernetes SA token based login to OpenBAO. If omitted you must set BAO_TOKEN.

pkiMount.description: The mount point of the PKI engine the bridge is working with

signRole.description: The role used for signing client certificates

raRole.description: The role use to generate the bridge's RA certificate

raTTL.description: The lifetime of the bridge's RA certificate (Go duration format)

raCommonName.description: Common name to use for the RA certificate to issue.

rootCaCertificate.description: Optionally, a root certificate to serve as part of the CA bundle if OpenBAO does not serve it as part of the CA chain
